brief: Out of 1,307 screened lots across New York City, 220 qualify for direct purchase offers and 145 represent city-owned RFP opportunities. This week we are targeting four top-performing sites in Brooklyn and Queens that offer strong yields under 485-x Option C and City of Yes UAP provisions. Outreach includes direct seller letters, a faith-based ground-lease joint venture, and local political engagement for city dispositions.
